title: Choose Your Experience
subtitle: From an authentic culinary masterclass to adrenaline-fueled dunes — discover the soul of Agadir.

services.name: Cooking Masterclass
services.description: An exclusive culinary journey through the flavours of Morocco. Visit the vibrant Souk to handpick fresh vegetables and spices, then learn the ancestral art of Tagine and Couscous alongside a traditional chef. Savour your creations with dessert and mint tea at the Kasbat Souss artisan complex — surrounded by 100% handmade Amazigh crafts.

services.name: Quad Biking
services.description: Feel the raw adrenaline as you tear across the golden desert dunes. This 2-hour off-road expedition puts you in control — wind in your face, sun on your back, and endless horizons ahead. Transport included.

services.name: Buggy Off-Road
services.description: Conquer the desert in a brand-new, powerful buggy. 2 hours of pure off-road exhilaration across majestic sand dunes and spectacular desert trails. Adrenaline meets breathtaking scenery. Transport included.

services.name: Horse Riding
services.description: Ride like the free Amazigh souls through the mystical Aghroud forests and across the legendary Souss River. Capture golden-hour photos, then gather for an authentic Moroccan experience with traditional mint tea, a delicious BBQ feast, laughter, and vibrant activities at Kasbat Souss. Perfect for beginners and experienced riders alike.

services.name: Camel Trekking
services.description: A magical desert journey at a gentle pace. Traverse the ancient Aghroud forest trails, photograph the shimmering Souss River, and arrive at Kasbat Souss for an unforgettable Moroccan gathering with traditional mint tea, a sizzling BBQ feast, laughter, and lively activities. Comfortable, authentic, and steeped in Amazigh heritage.

services.name: Pottery Workshop
services.description: Immerse yourself in the ancient art of Moroccan pottery. Work alongside skilled local artisans in a traditional workshop, shaping clay with your hands and learning centuries-old techniques passed down through generations. Create your own unique piece to take home as a lasting memory. After your creative session, celebrate your masterpiece with traditional mint tea, a sizzling BBQ feast, and joyful Moroccan atmosphere filled with laughter and lively activities.
